subject: Request: Availability annex + evidence matrix for Horizon Labs (custom SLA addendum)
messages:
From: Cecilia Nguyen <cecilia.nguyen@horizonlabs.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@horizonlabs.com
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Custom SLA addendum request — Availability exhibit + evidence

Hi Hannah / David,

Thanks for the demo last week — Horizon is ready to move forward pending two clarifications on SLA and evidence for our enterprise procurement team. Attached is our short request form (Horizon_SLA_Request_Form.pdf) that summarizes what legal/procurement will need. High level:

- We need an Availability Annex (addendum to the MSA) that pins regional uptime SLOs per-prod-region and the exact remedy schedule.
- A clear evidence matrix listing the artifacts Redwood will provide to validate uptime and latency (monthly uptime report, latency percentiles, incident timelines, SOC2 logs, audit logs, KMS attestations).
- Order form language for the uptime credit calculation and notification windows (we prefer 15 business days for notice on incidents).

Can your team provide a draft exhibit + an evidence checklist we can include with the order form? Procurement would like to see the evidence types and delivery cadence before they sign. If possible, include the ops contact who will handle evidence requests.

Cecilia Nguyen
Head of Platform Procurement
Horizon Labs
cecilia.nguyen@horizonlabs.com

Attachment: Horizon_SLA_Request_Form.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Cecilia Nguyen <cecilia.nguyen@horizonlabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Custom SLA addendum request — Availability exhibit + evidence

Cecilia — thanks for the clear ask and the form. We're happy to provide a tailored Availability Annex and an evidence matrix. Next steps from our side:

1) Marcus will draft an evidence matrix and consequence/credit schedule (we'll include delivery cadence).
2) David (ops) will confirm what operational evidence we can commit to (logs, monthly reports, latency percentiles) and how quickly we can produce them.
3) Grace (AM) will coordinate the commercial/orderform language and DocuSign timeline.

I'll attach an initial Redwood draft exhibit to get reactions. Could you share your procurement timeline (target sign date) and whether Horizon requires any on-prem audit access or replicated logs?

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-draft-availability-exhibit-v1.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Cecilia Nguyen <cecilia.nguyen@horizonlabs.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed evidence matrix + consequence table (draft)

Hi team — see the attached availability-evidence-matrix.xlsx for a structured proposal. Highlights below:

- Evidence types we can commit to: monthly uptime report (per-region), 50/90/99 latency percentiles (30/60/90 day windows), incident timeline with RCA (72 hours initial, 10 business days final), KV-cache warmup logs for prefix caching, aggregated token throughput for the reserved pool.
- Sensitive artifacts (full raw audit logs) — production: we can provide redacted extracts or KMS/HSM attestations; full raw logs could be available under a narrow, audited request via our compliance team.
- Remedies/consequence matrix: credits tiered by % monthly uptime below the SLO; separate treatment for scheduled maintenance (we propose pre-announced windows with a 7x per-year limit).
- Suggested orderform language snippet for credit calculation: "Monthly Credit = max(0, (SLO - MeasuredAvailability)/SLO) * MonthlyFee * CreditMultiplier" — open to legal phrasing.

Ask: David — confirm whether incident RCA cadence (72h initial/10bd final) is operationally feasible. Cecilia — please flag any evidence that is non-starter for you (e.g., if you need raw audit exports regularly).

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachment: availability-evidence-matrix.xlsx
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Cecilia Nguyen <cecilia.nguyen@horizonlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 14:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed evidence matrix + consequence table (draft)

Marcus — this looks good and realistic from an ops perspective. A few clarifications / constraints:

- Latency percentiles: we can commit 50/90/99 over rolling 7/30/90 day windows. We'll deliver percentile CSVs and a 30-day histogram export monthly.
- Incident timelines: 72-hour initial acknowledgement and a 10-business-day investigative RCA is fine, provided the scope doesn't include deep third-party infra telemetry (we'll provide what we host).
- Orderform language: we prefer the credit calc to reference "MeasuredAvailability as measured by Redwood's monitoring system with supporting exports provided on request" — keeps the mechanics clear and avoids dual-measurement fights.

Also flagging a note on maintenance: we can provide a 7-day advance notice for scheduled maintenance affecting availability >5% per-region; anything larger requires emergency coordination.

I'll incorporate these operational constraints into an updated exhibit and share as pdf.

-David
David Kim
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Cecilia Nguyen <cecilia.nguyen@horizonlabs.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@horizonlabs.com, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Timeline + DocuSign for Horizon Labs order form

Cecilia — quick commercial note. Based on the team's input:

- We'll turn the draft exhibit + evidence matrix into a single PDF bundle and the orderform redlines within 3 business days.
- Proposed sign target: 2026-02-26 (can compress if procurement needs it sooner).
- DocuSign: I will attach the orderform to DocuSign once legal redlines are reconciled. Preliminary DocuSign URL (for internal reference): https://www.docusign.net/embeddedSigning/abc123

If procurement can confirm PO timing, we can align the canary period (30 days) after execution to validate latency numbers in production.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
From: Cecilia Nguyen <cecilia.nguyen@horizonlabs.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@horizonlabs.com, procurement@horizonlabs.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Timeline + DocuSign for Horizon Labs order form

Thanks — appreciation for the quick turnaround. We reviewed Marcus / David's proposals in procurement & legal. In principle these look OK, but legal will send a short redline removing the "regional fallback" automatic reroute clause (we require explicit consent before cross-region fallback for data residency reasons). Attached: Horizon_legal_redlines_v1.pdf.

We'll get formal redlines to you by EOD Friday and confirm PO timing. Cecilia
Cecilia Nguyen
Head of Platform Procurement
Horizon Labs

Attachment: Horizon_legal_redlines_v1.pdf
